title: Publish Week 1 traffic-sprint JSON manifest in public web root
description:
Roadmap lane: traffic. Posting has not started; operators need a single canonical artifact for Days 1–7 so execution and logging are consistent with `docs/traffic-sprint-14-day.md`. Add a small static JSON file (or equivalent App Router public asset) that mirrors the first week of the sprint plan—no copywriting net-new beyond lifting from existing docs.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-17T23:46:05.142Z
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP GET `https://starmapco.com/traffic-sprint-week1.json` (or the repo’s configured production origin + exact path you choose) returns HTTP 200 with `Content-Type` containing `json`, a JSON object with key `days`, and `days.length === 7` where each element includes non-empty string fields `day` and `channel`.
testPlan: Use `curl -fsS -D -` against the production URL and parse JSON with `node -e` or `jq` to assert schema and length.
